claim.statement: The existing DynamicBulkColumnDeclaration grammar and physical reader now compose through OfflineTable[column].values as retained immutable BinaryValue entries. trust.G: Affected consumer cohorts and eight finite native carrier/profile matrices; not all ClickHouse type/layout products.
trust.R: ROOT observed and dereferenced final commands/logs/artifact pins. Luna's static review is correlated and not independent runtime replication.

boundaries.rollback: Revert the single coherent local W220 commit without discarding other user work. The separate legacy fix is an antecedent, not part of this diff. No push or history rewrite.
accepted: Existing Dynamic-bearing root, Array, Tuple and root Nested grammar, including previously admitted ordinary bound and inline shared JSON actuals.
Exact nominal schema, row counts and P mark axes; each immutable part may have a different actual roster/profile.
Complete schedule preflight of all candidates before result allocation; part reopens repeat identity checks.
Reserve final union slots and descriptor; atomically charge a whole mark's retained recursive values before append.
Cumulative row/String/cell/descriptor/node/element/depth/logical byte limits and actual data/structure-grid owner census.
Empty selection only after declaration, alias, MV access and hard-limit admission. Exact bare Dynamic keeps its existing specialized route.
rejected_or_not_claimed: New declarations, buried Nested grammar, noncanonical spelling, unsupported layouts/codecs or physical zero-row Dynamic parts.
Fallback from corrupt generic physical data to legacy decoding.
All transient JSON/LowCardinality decoded descendant allocations, allocator capacity/RSS or a 64 MiB peak-memory certificate.
Checksum payload hash verification by production, whole-scan callback atomicity, performance improvement.
New writer wire profile, library-side native owned .values qualification, native full catalog/database discovery.
MV definition execution, projection writing/freshness/provenance or repository-wide facade decomposition.

require 'json'
require './scripts/check_dynamic_owned_evidence_w220'
audit = CheckDynamicOwnedEvidenceW220
rejected = 0
controls = 0
ARGV.each do |argument|
  label, root, pin = argument.split('=', 3)
  kind, mode = label.split(':', 2)
  summary = JSON.parse(File.binread(File.join(root, 'summary.json')))
  raw = JSON.parse(File.binread(File.join(root, 'invocations', 'crystal_helper.stdout')))
  audit.validate_helper_observations!(kind, raw)
  audit.validate_runtime!(kind, summary)
  record = summary.fetch('invocations').find { |item| item['stdout_file'] == 'crystal_helper.stdout' }
  audit.validate_helper_pin!(record, pin, kind)
  attached = File.binread(File.join(root, 'invocations', 'attach_and_check.stdout'))
  audit.validate_raw_checks!(kind, 'attached', attached)
  controls += 1
  mutations = {
    'payload signature' => proc { |h| h['cases'][0]['source']['owned_values']['values_by_mark'][0][0] = 'wrong actual payload' },
    'nominal descriptor' => proc { |h| h['cases'][0]['source']['owned_values']['nominal_type_names_by_mark'][0][0] = 'String' },
    'row/mark grid' => proc { |h| h['cases'][0]['source']['owned_values']['mark_row_counts'] = [1,3] + h['cases'][0]['source']['owned_values']['mark_row_counts'].drop(2) },
    'missing case' => proc { |h| h['cases'].pop },
    'missing owned values' => proc { |h| h['cases'][0]['source'].delete('owned_values') },
    'enclosing identity' => proc { |h| h['cases'][0]['case_id'] = 'unrostered' },
  }
  mutations.each do |name, mutate|
    changed = Marshal.load(Marshal.dump(raw))
    mutate.call(changed)
    audit.expect_rejected!("#{label} #{name}") { audit.validate_helper_observations!(kind, changed) }
    rejected += 1
  end
  substituted = record.merge('expected_binary_sha256' => '0' * 64, 'binary_sha_after' => '0' * 64)
  audit.expect_rejected!("#{label} self-consistent substituted helper") { audit.validate_helper_pin!(substituted, pin, kind) }
  rejected += 1
  missing_check = attached.sub(/^__W(?:203|202)_CHECK_BEGIN__\t[^\n]*\n.*?^__W(?:203|202)_CHECK_END__\t[^\n]*\n/m, '')
  raise 'CHECK mutation did not change raw bytes' if missing_check == attached
  audit.expect_rejected!("#{label} missing attached CHECK") { audit.validate_raw_checks!(kind, 'attached', missing_check) }
  rejected += 1
  if kind == 'w212'
    changed = Marshal.load(Marshal.dump(summary))
    changed['binary_sha256_before'] = '0' * 64
    audit.expect_rejected!("#{label} actual top-level binary pin") { audit.validate_runtime!(kind, changed) }
    rejected += 1
  end
  puts "#{label}: clean actual observation accepted; semantic and identity mutants rejected"
end
puts "Actual raw-evidence mutation guard: #{controls} clean controls, #{rejected} rejected mutants; no evidence files modified."
